summary: Revenue rose from $765.1M in 2023 to $850.0M in 2024 and $955.8M in 2025, a 12.44% growth in 2025, so market potential passes. The 2025 operating margin of 13.36% (revenue $955.8M vs total cost $828.1M) exceeds the industrial robotics industry median of 9.4%, so the profit margin point passes. However, the margin slipped from 14.50% in FY2024 to 13.36% in FY2025, indicating margins were not maintained or improved.

Revenue rose in each year from $228,000k (2023) to $243,947.5k (2024) to $269,763.4k (2025), a 2025 growth rate of about 10.6%, well above the 8% threshold, so Point 1 passes. The 2025 operating margin was 12.63% (revenue $269,763.4k less total costs $235,699.9k), exceeding the packaging machinery industry median of 10.30%, passing Point 5. Margins also improved year over year, from 11.38% in FY2024 to 12.63% in FY2025, so Point 6 passes as well.

Revenue rose steadily from $230.4M in 2023 to $250.7M in 2024 and $279.0M in 2025, an 11.28% 2025 growth rate that clears the 8% threshold. FY2025 operating margin of 13.64% ($279.0M revenue vs. $240.9M total costs) exceeds the water treatment equipment industry median of 11.90%, and improved slightly from FY2024's 13.31%, indicating maintained-to-improving profitability.
